x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.description:
This fix script updates the Now Mobile home page banner to use the Polaris theme image by replacing the image field on the Coral banner record (sn_me_static_media_section) with the sys_id of the Polaris image. Before running, set runManually to true to confirm
Caution: The Script should only be executed once. Carefully review before proceeding.
x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.name: Revert Now Mobile Home Banner
